questionText.en: A $20\text{ kg}$ crate is pulled along a rough horizontal floor by an $80\text{ N}$ force at $30^\circ$ above the horizontal. The crate accelerates at $1.2\text{ m·s}^{-2}$. Calculate the kinetic frictional force.
questionText.af: 'n $20\text{ kg}$-krat word oor 'n growwe horisontale vloer getrek deur 'n $80\text{ N}$-krag teen $30^\circ$ bo die horisontaal. Die krat versnel teen $1.2\text{ m·s}^{-2}$. Bereken die kinetiese wrywingskrag.
questionText.xh: Ikreyithi ye-$20\text{ kg}$ itsalwa kumgangatho oxwesileyo orhabaxa ngamandla ayi-$80\text{ N}$ kwi-engile ye-$30^\circ$ ngaphezu komgca oxwesileyo. Ikreyithi inyusa isantya nge-$1.2\text{ m·s}^{-2}$. Bala amandla okukhuhlana ashukumayo.

scaffoldHint.en: Resolve the pulling force horizontally: $F_x=F\cos30^\circ$. Then use $F_{net}=ma$ and $F_x-f_k=ma$.
scaffoldHint.af: Ontbind die trekkrag horisontaal: $F_x=F\cos30^\circ$. Gebruik dan $F_{net}=ma$ en $F_x-f_k=ma$.
scaffoldHint.xh: Yahlula amandla okutsala ngokuxwesileyo: $F_x=F\cos30^\circ$. Emva koko sebenzisa $F_{net}=ma$ kunye no-$F_x-f_k=ma$.

questionText.en: A $1\,200\text{ kg}$ car travelling east at $20\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ slows uniformly to $5\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ east in $3\text{ s}$. Calculate the impulse on the car and the average net force.
questionText.af: 'n $1\,200\text{ kg}$-motor wat oos teen $20\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ beweeg, vertraag eweredig tot $5\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ oos in $3\text{ s}$. Bereken die impuls op die motor en die gemiddelde netto krag.
questionText.xh: Imoto ye-$1\,200\text{ kg}$ ehamba empuma nge-$20\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ iyacotha ngokulinganayo iye kwi-$5\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ empuma ngemizuzwana eyi-$3$. Bala i-impulse kunye namandla aphakathi e-net.

scaffoldHint.en: Take east as positive. Use $J=\Delta p=m(v_f-v_i)$ and $F_{net}=J/\Delta t$.
scaffoldHint.af: Neem oos as positief. Gebruik $J=\Delta p=m(v_f-v_i)$ en $F_{net}=J/\Delta t$.
scaffoldHint.xh: Thatha impuma njenge-positive. Sebenzisa $J=\Delta p=m(v_f-v_i)$ kunye no-$F_{net}=J/\Delta t$.

memoText.en:
$J=1200(5-20)=-18\,000\text{ N·s}$. The negative sign means west.
$F_{net}=(-18\,000)/3=-6\,000\text{ N}$, so the average net force is $6\,000\text{ N}$ west.
memoText.af:
$J=1200(5-20)=-18\,000\text{ N·s}$. Die negatiewe teken beteken wes.
$F_{net}=(-18\,000)/3=-6\,000\text{ N}$, dus is die gemiddelde netto krag $6\,000\text{ N}$ wes.
memoText.xh:
$J=1200(5-20)=-18\,000\text{ N·s}$. Uphawu olungalunganga luthetha intshona.
$F_{net}=(-18\,000)/3=-6\,000\text{ N}$, ngoko amandla aphakathi e-net ayi-$6\,000\text{ N}$ entshona.

questionText.en: A ball is projected vertically upward from ground level at $19.6\text{ m·s}^{-1}$. Ignore air resistance. Calculate the time to reach maximum height and the maximum height above the launch point.
questionText.af: 'n Bal word vertikaal opwaarts vanaf grondvlak teen $19.6\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ geprojekteer. Ignoreer lugweerstand. Bereken die tyd om maksimum hoogte te bereik en die maksimum hoogte bo die lanseerpunt.
questionText.xh: Ibhola iphoswa nkqo phezulu ukusuka emhlabeni ngesantya se-$19.6\text{ m·s}^{-1}$. Ungahoyi ukuxhathisa komoya. Bala ixesha lokufikelela kubude obuphezulu kunye nobude obuphezulu ngaphezu kwendawo yokuphoswa.

scaffoldHint.en: At maximum height $v_f=0$. Use $v_f=v_i+a\Delta t$ with $a=-9.8\text{ m·s}^{-2}$, then $v_f^2=v_i^2+2a\Delta y$.
scaffoldHint.af: By maksimum hoogte is $v_f=0$. Gebruik $v_f=v_i+a\Delta t$ met $a=-9.8\text{ m·s}^{-2}$, en dan $v_f^2=v_i^2+2a\Delta y$.
scaffoldHint.xh: Kubude obuphezulu $v_f=0$. Sebenzisa $v_f=v_i+a\Delta t$ apho $a=-9.8\text{ m·s}^{-2}$, emva koko $v_f^2=v_i^2+2a\Delta y$.

questionText.en: A $2\text{ kg}$ trolley starts from rest. The net work done on it is $100\text{ J}$. Use the work-energy theorem to calculate its final speed.
questionText.af: 'n $2\text{ kg}$-trollie begin uit rus. Die netto arbeid wat daarop verrig word, is $100\text{ J}$. Gebruik die arbeid-energietelling om die finale spoed te bereken.
questionText.xh: Itroli ye-$2\text{ kg}$ iqala iphumle. Umsebenzi we-net owenziwe kuyo yi-$100\text{ J}$. Sebenzisa i-work-energy theorem ukubala isantya sayo sokugqibela.

questionText.en: An ambulance moves away from a stationary observer at $25\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ while its siren emits $680\text{ Hz}$. Take the speed of sound as $340\text{ m·s}^{-1}$. Calculate the observed frequency.
questionText.af: 'n Ambulans beweeg weg van 'n stilstaande waarnemer teen $25\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ terwyl die sirene $680\text{ Hz}$ uitstraal. Neem die klankspoed as $340\text{ m·s}^{-1}$. Bereken die waargenome frekwensie.
questionText.xh: I-ambulensi ihamba isuka kummameli omileyo nge-$25\text{ m·s}^{-1}$ ngelixa isireni ikhupha $680\text{ Hz}$. Thatha isantya sesandi njenge-$340\text{ m·s}^{-1}$. Bala i-frequency eviwayo.

scaffoldHint.en: For a stationary listener and a source moving away, use $f_L=\frac{v}{v+v_S}f_S$.
scaffoldHint.af: Vir 'n stilstaande luisteraar en 'n bron wat wegbeweeg, gebruik $f_L=\frac{v}{v+v_S}f_S$.
scaffoldHint.xh: Kummameli omileyo kunye nomthombo ohamba kude, sebenzisa $f_L=\frac{v}{v+v_S}f_S$.

questionText.en: Two point charges, $+2\,\mu\text{C}$ and $-3\,\mu\text{C}$, are $0.20\text{ m}$ apart in vacuum. Calculate the magnitude of the electrostatic force between them and state whether it is attractive or repulsive.
questionText.af: Twee puntladings, $+2\,\mu\text{C}$ en $-3\,\mu\text{C}$, is $0.20\text{ m}$ uitmekaar in vakuum. Bereken die grootte van die elektrostatiese krag tussen hulle en sê of dit aantrekkend of afstotend is.
questionText.xh: Iitshaji ezimbini, $+2\,\mu\text{C}$ kunye no-$-3\,\mu\text{C}$, zikude nge-$0.20\text{ m}$ kwi-vacuum. Bala ubukhulu bamandla e-electrostatic phakathi kwazo kwaye uchaze ukuba ayatsalana okanye ayatyhalana.

memoText.en: $F=9.0\times10^9\frac{(2\times10^{-6})(3\times10^{-6})}{(0.20)^2}=1.35\text{ N}$. Opposite charges attract, so the force is attractive.
memoText.af: $F=9.0\times10^9\frac{(2\times10^{-6})(3\times10^{-6})}{(0.20)^2}=1.35\text{ N}$. Teenoorgestelde ladings trek mekaar aan, dus is die krag aantrekkend.
memoText.xh: $F=9.0\times10^9\frac{(2\times10^{-6})(3\times10^{-6})}{(0.20)^2}=1.35\text{ N}$. Iitshaji ezichaseneyo ziyatsalana, ngoko amandla ayatsalana.

questionText.en: A $6\,\Omega$ resistor and a $3\,\Omega$ resistor are connected in parallel. This combination is connected in series with a $4\,\Omega$ resistor across a $12\text{ V}$ battery. Calculate the total resistance and the total current.
questionText.af: 'n $6\,\Omega$-weerstand en 'n $3\,\Omega$-weerstand is parallel verbind. Hierdie kombinasie is in serie met 'n $4\,\Omega$-weerstand oor 'n $12\text{ V}$-battery verbind. Bereken die totale weerstand en totale stroom.
questionText.xh: I-resistor ye-$6\,\Omega$ kunye neye-$3\,\Omega$ zidityaniswe nge-parallel. Le ndibaniselwano idityaniswe nge-series ne-$4\,\Omega$ resistor kwi-battery ye-$12\text{ V}$. Bala i-resistance iyonke kunye ne-current iyonke.

scaffoldHint.en: First find the parallel equivalent: $1/R_p=1/6+1/3$. Then add the series resistor and use $I=V/R$.
scaffoldHint.af: Bereken eers die parallelle ekwivalente weerstand: $1/R_p=1/6+1/3$. Tel dan die serieweerstand by en gebruik $I=V/R$.
scaffoldHint.xh: Qala ufumane i-resistance ye-parallel: $1/R_p=1/6+1/3$. Emva koko yongeza i-resistor ye-series uze usebenzise $I=V/R$.

questionText.en: An AC generator supplies a household voltage with an RMS value of $220\text{ V}$. Calculate the peak voltage.
questionText.af: 'n WS-generator lewer 'n huishoudelike spanning met 'n WGK-waarde van $220\text{ V}$. Bereken die piekspanning.
questionText.xh: I-AC generator inika i-voltage yasekhaya ene-RMS value eyi-$220\text{ V}$. Bala i-peak voltage.

questionText.en: Light of frequency $8.0\times10^{14}\text{ Hz}$ shines on a metal with work function $2.0\text{ eV}$. Calculate the maximum kinetic energy of the emitted electrons in joules. Use $h=6.63\times10^{-34}\text{ J·s}$ and $1\text{ eV}=1.60\times10^{-19}\text{ J}$.
questionText.af: Lig met frekwensie $8.0\times10^{14}\text{ Hz}$ skyn op 'n metaal met arbeidsfunksie $2.0\text{ eV}$. Bereken die maksimum kinetiese energie van die vrygestelde elektrone in joule. Gebruik $h=6.63\times10^{-34}\text{ J·s}$ en $1\text{ eV}=1.60\times10^{-19}\text{ J}$.
questionText.xh: Ukukhanya kwe-frequency $8.0\times10^{14}\text{ Hz}$ kubetha isinyithi esine-work function ye-$2.0\text{ eV}$. Bala i-maximum kinetic energy yee-electron ezikhutshiweyo nge-joule. Sebenzisa $h=6.63\times10^{-34}\text{ J·s}$ kunye no-$1\text{ eV}=1.60\times10^{-19}\text{ J}$.

scaffoldHint.en: Use $E=hf$ and $K_{max}=hf-W_0$. Convert the work function from eV to J first.
scaffoldHint.af: Gebruik $E=hf$ en $K_{max}=hf-W_0$. Skakel eers die arbeidsfunksie van eV na J om.
scaffoldHint.xh: Sebenzisa $E=hf$ kunye no-$K_{max}=hf-W_0$. Guqula i-work function ukusuka kwi-eV iye kwi-J kuqala.

questionText.en: Ethanoic acid reacts with ethanol. Name the type of organic product formed and give its IUPAC name.
questionText.af: Etanoësuur reageer met etanol. Noem die tipe organiese produk wat vorm en gee die IUPAC-naam daarvan.
questionText.xh: I-ethanoic acid isabela ne-ethanol. Chaza uhlobo lwemveliso ye-organic eyenziwayo uze unike igama layo le-IUPAC.

scaffoldHint.en: A carboxylic acid reacting with an alcohol forms an ester and water. The alcohol supplies the alkyl part of the ester name.
scaffoldHint.af: 'n Karboksielsuur wat met 'n alkohol reageer vorm 'n ester en water. Die alkohol verskaf die alkieldeel van die ester se naam.
scaffoldHint.xh: I-carboxylic acid xa isabela ne-alcohol yenza i-ester namanzi. I-alcohol inika indawo ye-alkyl kwigama le-ester.

questionText.en: During a reaction, $60\text{ cm}^3$ of hydrogen gas is produced in $30\text{ s}$. Calculate the average rate of gas production in $\text{cm}^3\text{·s}^{-1}$ and state one way a catalyst increases reaction rate.
questionText.af: Tydens 'n reaksie word $60\text{ cm}^3$ waterstofgas in $30\text{ s}$ gevorm. Bereken die gemiddelde tempo van gasvorming in $\text{cm}^3\text{·s}^{-1}$ en noem een manier waarop 'n katalisator die reaksietempo verhoog.
questionText.xh: Ngexesha le-reaction kuveliswa $60\text{ cm}^3$ ye-hydrogen gas kwi-$30\text{ s}$. Bala i-average rate yokuveliswa kwegesi nge-$\text{cm}^3\text{·s}^{-1}$ uze uchaze indlela enye i-catalyst eyandisa ngayo i-reaction rate.

scaffoldHint.en: Average rate = change in measurable quantity divided by time. A catalyst provides an alternative pathway with lower activation energy.
scaffoldHint.af: Gemiddelde tempo = verandering in meetbare hoeveelheid gedeel deur tyd. 'n Katalisator bied 'n alternatiewe reaksiepad met laer aktiveringsenergie.
scaffoldHint.xh: Average rate = utshintsho kubungakanani obulinganisiweyo lwahlulwe ngexesha. I-catalyst inika indlela eyahlukileyo ene-activation energy ephantsi.

memoText.en:
Average rate $=60/30=2.0\text{ cm}^3\text{·s}^{-1}$.
A catalyst increases rate by providing an alternative reaction pathway with lower activation energy.
memoText.af:
Gemiddelde tempo $=60/30=2.0\text{ cm}^3\text{·s}^{-1}$.
'n Katalisator verhoog die tempo deur 'n alternatiewe reaksiepad met laer aktiveringsenergie te bied.
memoText.xh:
Average rate $=60/30=2.0\text{ cm}^3\text{·s}^{-1}$.
I-catalyst yandisa i-rate ngokunika indlela ye-reaction ene-activation energy ephantsi.

questionText.en: For $\text{N}_2(g)+3\text{H}_2(g)\rightleftharpoons2\text{NH}_3(g)$ in a closed $2\text{ dm}^3$ container, the equilibrium amounts are $0.4\text{ mol}$ $\text{N}_2$, $0.6\text{ mol}$ $\text{H}_2$ and $0.8\text{ mol}$ $\text{NH}_3$. Calculate $K_c$.
questionText.af: Vir $\text{N}_2(g)+3\text{H}_2(g)\rightleftharpoons2\text{NH}_3(g)$ in 'n geslote $2\text{ dm}^3$-houer is die ewewigshoeveelhede $0.4\text{ mol}$ $\text{N}_2$, $0.6\text{ mol}$ $\text{H}_2$ en $0.8\text{ mol}$ $\text{NH}_3$. Bereken $K_c$.
questionText.xh: Kwi-$\text{N}_2(g)+3\text{H}_2(g)\rightleftharpoons2\text{NH}_3(g)$ kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo se-$2\text{ dm}^3$, iimali kwi-equilibrium zi-$0.4\text{ mol}$ $\text{N}_2$, $0.6\text{ mol}$ $\text{H}_2$ kunye ne-$0.8\text{ mol}$ $\text{NH}_3$. Bala $K_c$.

scaffoldHint.en: First convert moles to concentrations using $c=n/V$. Then use $K_c=[NH_3]^2/([N_2][H_2]^3)$.
scaffoldHint.af: Skakel eers mol na konsentrasies om met $c=n/V$. Gebruik dan $K_c=[NH_3]^2/([N_2][H_2]^3)$.
scaffoldHint.xh: Qala uguqule ii-moles zibe yi-concentration usebenzisa $c=n/V$. Emva koko sebenzisa $K_c=[NH_3]^2/([N_2][H_2]^3)$.

questionText.en: A hydrochloric acid solution has concentration $0.010\text{ mol·dm}^{-3}$. Calculate its pH, assuming complete ionisation. Then calculate the volume of $0.20\text{ mol·dm}^{-3}$ NaOH needed to neutralise $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ of $0.10\text{ mol·dm}^{-3}$ HCl.
questionText.af: 'n Soutsuuroplossing het 'n konsentrasie van $0.010\text{ mol·dm}^{-3}$. Bereken die pH, met volledige ionisasie aanvaar. Bereken dan die volume $0.20\text{ mol·dm}^{-3}$ NaOH wat nodig is om $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ van $0.10\text{ mol·dm}^{-3}$ HCl te neutraliseer.
questionText.xh: Isisombululo se-hydrochloric acid sine-concentration ye-$0.010\text{ mol·dm}^{-3}$. Bala i-pH, ucinge ukuba i-ionisation iphelele. Emva koko bala i-volume ye-$0.20\text{ mol·dm}^{-3}$ NaOH efunekayo uku-neutralise $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ ye-$0.10\text{ mol·dm}^{-3}$ HCl.

scaffoldHint.en: For strong HCl, $[H_3O^+]=0.010$ and $pH=-\log[H_3O^+]$. For neutralisation use $n=cV$ and the 1:1 HCl:NaOH ratio.
scaffoldHint.af: Vir sterk HCl is $[H_3O^+]=0.010$ en $pH=-\log[H_3O^+]$. Vir neutralisasie gebruik $n=cV$ en die 1:1 HCl:NaOH-verhouding.
scaffoldHint.xh: Kwi-HCl eyomeleleyo, $[H_3O^+]=0.010$ kwaye $pH=-\log[H_3O^+]$. Kwi-neutralisation sebenzisa $n=cV$ kunye ne-1:1 ratio ye-HCl:NaOH.

questionText.en: A standard galvanic cell is made from Zn/Zn$^{2+}$ and Cu$^{2+}$/Cu half-cells. Given $E^\circ(\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu})=+0.34\text{ V}$ and $E^\circ(\text{Zn}^{2+}/\text{Zn})=-0.76\text{ V}$, identify the anode and cathode and calculate $E^\circ_{cell}$.
questionText.af: 'n Standaard galvaniese sel bestaan uit Zn/Zn$^{2+}$- en Cu$^{2+}$/Cu-half­selle. Gegee $E^\circ(\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu})=+0.34\text{ V}$ en $E^\circ(\text{Zn}^{2+}/\text{Zn})=-0.76\text{ V}$, identifiseer die anode en katode en bereken $E^\circ_{sel}$.
questionText.xh: I-galvanic cell esemgangathweni yenziwe nge-Zn/Zn$^{2+}$ kunye ne-Cu$^{2+}$/Cu half-cells. Xa $E^\circ(\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu})=+0.34\text{ V}$ kunye no-$E^\circ(\text{Zn}^{2+}/\text{Zn})=-0.76\text{ V}$, chonga i-anode ne-cathode uze ubale $E^\circ_{cell}$.

scaffoldHint.en: The half-reaction with the more positive reduction potential occurs at the cathode. Use $E^\circ_{cell}=E^\circ_{cathode}-E^\circ_{anode}$.
scaffoldHint.af: Die halfreaksie met die meer positiewe reduksiepotensiaal vind by die katode plaas. Gebruik $E^\circ_{sel}=E^\circ_{katode}-E^\circ_{anode}$.
scaffoldHint.xh: I-half-reaction ene-reduction potential ephezulu kakhulu yenzeka kwi-cathode. Sebenzisa $E^\circ_{cell}=E^\circ_{cathode}-E^\circ_{anode}$.
